convergence_register.evidence_text: PM-KISAN operational guidelines (Clause 3) and PMFBY operational guidelines (Clause 4.4) confirm that income support under PM-KISAN is independent of statutory crop loss insurance. Receiving PM-KISAN does not preclude or reduce PMFBY claim payout.

The Ministry of Agriculture launched a dedicated national saturation campaign actively encouraging all active PM-KISAN beneficiaries to obtain Kisan Credit Cards without extra processing fee up to Rs. 1.6 Lakh limit.
convergence_register.authoritative_source: Department of Financial Services / MoA&FW Joint Saturation Circular 2020

convergence_register.evidence_text: Kisan Credit Card holders cultivating notified crops are automatically enrolled for PMFBY coverage through their loan account unless an explicit opt-out declaration is filed before the seasonal deadline.

Micro-irrigation systems under Horticulture Department and farm mechanization equipment under Agriculture Department apply to distinct physical capital assets. Both subsidies can be availed concurrently on the same farm without duplication penalty.
convergence_register.authoritative_source: UP State Agriculture Convergence Advisory Committee Resolution 2023

convergence_register.evidence_text: UP Mukhyamantri Krishak Durghatna Kalyan Yojana is a social security accident benefit for registered farmers and laborers, distinct from the central agricultural income support scheme. Both remain fully combinable.
convergence_register.authoritative_source: UP Revenue Department Notification No. 1420/1-11-2020-04(01)/2020 Rule 6
